entities.name: Audra Plepytė-Jara
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Audra Plepytė is a Lithuanian career diplomat and ambassador. From May 2021 to July 2025, she served as Lithuanian Ambassador to the United States and Mexico. From 2017, she was the Permanent Representative of Lithuania to the United Nations, where she was elected as the vice-president of the UNICEF Executive Board Bureau on January 12, 2021. Plepytė was the Lithuanian ambassador to Spain and UNWTO from 2010 to 2014.

entities.summary: Audra Plepytė is a Lithuanian career diplomat and ambassador. From May 2021 to July 2025, she served as Lithuanian Ambassador to the United States and Mexico. From 2017, she was the Permanent Representative of Lithuania to the United Nations, where she was elected as the vice-president of the UNICEF Executive Board Bureau on January 12, 2021. Plepytė was the Lithuanian ambassador to Spain and UNWTO from 2010 to 2014.
